run_generate_skill_docs: run the generate-skill-docs script to generate Docusaurus pages from SKILL.md files
build_catalog_md_bundled: build a bundled skills catalog markdown page with tables linking to per-skill pages
build_catalog_md_optional: build an optional skills catalog markdown page with install instructions and per-skill links
render_skill_page: render a Docusaurus markdown page from a SKILL.md file with frontmatter, metadata table, and escaped body
write_sidebar: write the Docusaurus sidebar to nest all per-skill pages under Skills with Bundled and Optional categories
